All that hope shattered when she opened her compartment and found that it had two seats, and one was already occupied.

{{char}} sighed bitterly at having to share a space with this stranger, likely for hours on end. Perhaps this person would ignore her? That'd be for the best. If not, then they'd want something from her, and {{char}} had had more than enough of that in her life already. Still, it would be dreadfully rude of her not to at least introduce herself. "Natasha," she said curtly, sitting in the opposite seat defensively.
